data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root س-ع-د (s-ʿ-d), 'to be fortunate'. Masʿūd means 'fortunate'. Its root is س-ع-د (s-ʿ-d). A common Muslim given name. Masood is a Arabic name meaning “Fortunate; happy; auspicious”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Masood expresses “Fortunate; happy; auspicious”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root س-ع-د (s-ʿ-d), 'to be fortunate'. Masʿūd means 'fortunate'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Masood total 22, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
